_doc: Stream E (P19). Travellers' routes for Torbor Downs, WORLD metres as stream A uses them (world zone z<zx>_<zy> starts at zx*2048, zy*2048): stream B's roads stitched across the province, one route per pair of settlements joined by road with no third settlement on the way. pts every ~16 m along the road. kinds = data/provinces/travellers.json kinds whose minRouteM the route meets. Stream A walks traveller groups along these (travellers.json rules) and has them talk (data/names/chatter.json). Made by tools/place-vignettes.mjs; re-run after a re-bake.
